title: Spiritual Warfare and Deliverance
description: An elective course on the biblical teaching about Satan, demons and the believer's spiritual warfare, and on the church's ministry of deliverance. Students study the Old and New Testament data, Christ's victory over the powers, the armor of God, the patristic and medieval traditions (Antony, Cassian, Tertullian, Justin, the baptismal exorcisms), Reformation and Wesleyan perspectives, and contemporary charismatic practice - alongside the cautions raised by critics. The course stresses pastoral wisdom, accountability, care for the vulnerable, and partnership with medical and mental-health professionals.

lessons.paper_prompt: Write a 1,500-2,000 word pastoral theology of spiritual warfare and deliverance. Include the biblical foundations, insights from church history (at least two library sources, such as Athanasius, Cassian, Justin, Tertullian, Calvin or Wesley; cite as Author, Title, section), a fair presentation of at least two contemporary approaches and their critics, and a set of pastoral guidelines with safeguards, including collaboration with medical and mental-health care.
